en.text: That, uh…. That is a very scary man.
Abrams has them on the run!
They took out the Pigeon Lady!
Now let's go finish them off…
They took out the Chess Guy!
Paradox put them right where she wants them!
They took out the Test Pilot!
That was looking rough for a minute…
Thanks for taking care of us, McGinnis…
We were getting worried for a minute.
Good thing you were here, McGinnis…
Hold the line until I'm back McGinnis
One of the few times I'm happy to see a wall…
I'll be back when I can Geist
Geist is still in the fight!
Good god that woman is horrifying…
I'm glad he's on our side…
Mo. If we ever find out Haze is after us we're leaving town.
So that's what a sandman does…
Good lord that was lot of bullets…
Where did you learn to shoot like that?
I think I just saw a pilgrim take someone's head off…
Infernus, your misspent youth is being put to good use…
Infernus, don't you die on me
I knew I could count on you, Kelvin…
Thanks for keeping us in the fight.
Now there goes a man with gusto
Well, at least he's as good as he thinks he is…
I won't leave you alone for long Mirage
I was worried we wouldn’t make it…
They took out the Rat King!
I love watching that knife wielding lothario work.
Shiv fights like a man possessed!
Ivy, I love working with you…
This is the best sewer sludge I've ever bathed in…
Thank god Warden is on our side.
They didn't have a chance in hell…
The dead don't get to opine on what was or wasn't fair..
That thing's a monster, but at least he's on our side…
They thought they were getting away, didn't they…
Maurice is gonna rip your arms off!
You think you can do that and walk away?
They're cheating. That's what's happening, they're cheating.
Let's find a safe place to train.
Be careful, Maurice, it's just us out here.
If things go bad we need an exit strategy.
I don't know about you, Mo, but I'm feeling a little exposed…
We need to get out of here!
It takes more than that to kill us!
If we don't watch ourselves this thing'll be over…
We can't afford to make mistakes.
We need to keep it together…
If we don't step it up we're dead…
This is getting a little tense…
We keep this up, they won't have a chance in hell.
We need to keep the advantage!
We still have fight left in us!
Glad we put a stop to that…
Momo, I think we have a problem…
You'll have to do better than that, Paradox…
You thought you had an advantage, didn't you…
Look out for the black hole!
She keeps putting up these damn turrets…
Place as many as you want, McGinnis, we'll smash them all.
We need to regroup, they have the Rejuvenator!
Geist is going to look to steal your health.
You thought you could hide, didn't you, Haze…
You're not as clever as you thought, Haze…
You thought you'd be safe up there?
<Maurice growls> No Maurice, it wasn't a lucky shot!
And that's why you go underground when you're trying to escape…
You picked the wrong fight, Lash….
Oh, Lash, your ego got the better of you…
You mistake bravado with competence, my friend.
The owl is on the hunt!
This is going to be harder than we thought, isn't it…
This should be over in no time!
Don't think things could be going any better!
When Maurice finds you, you're done for…
Why delay the inevitable, just come out and die…
You can't hide from us forever.
The spirit urn is almost full
Should we head to the bridge?
There'll be an urn on the bridge soon…
That spirit jar could be worth a small fortune…
Someone might want to collect that urn!
We need to decide if we want the urn…
Might be worth checking out the bridge…
Who knows how long it will be before somoene tries to collect that spirit jar…
We just gotta keep doing that!
Why couldn't she go to Liberty Island like most tourists…
Out of towners, am I right?
The sheriff is off our case for a little while…
He made us work for that, didn't he, Mo…
That was a big boy, wasn't it…
Abrams won't be bothering us for a while…
Lash would have at least put up a fight…
You won't be hooking anyone for a while…
Maurice, you gave that robot a helluva beating…
Perhaps next time we'll be on the same side, Paige.
I like you, Paige. Not enough to not kill you. But enough to feel a little bad about it.
A shame we never started that book club, Paige.
I'll give her a book later and all will be forgiven.
She didn't leave us a choice, Maurice
Pity, she was a good singer, too…
Sorry, Momo. She did not leave us a choice.
She was a clever one… but clever only gets you so far.
She made some questionable life decisions…
Be on guard, Momo… she'll be back.
Ohhh she's not gonna be happy about that…
Murderous Doorman or no, The Baroness still has the best mimosas on Manhattan.
Don't listen to him, Momo… I would never betray you.
He tried to turn us against each other, and he paid for it.
We won't let you prey on the people of New York.
That man had no remorse…. No humanity.
We didn't stop The Drifter… we only slowed him down.
He was a cute little guy.
I hope he finds a way home.
A shame he couldn't pick better friends.
If only we got to him sooner, we could have helped him.
And he thought he was better than us…
And I now I feel like I've seen what Lash acted like as a teenager.
The arrogance that radiated off that boy was astounding.
Blackmore Academy: the breeding ground for Manhattan's finest narcissists.
Whatever Fairfax is paying you, it's too much…
Those little machines were never going to be enough.
Alas, some mysteries will never get solved, Victor.
Victor, you had the soul of a poet…. It's a shame you fought with the competence of one as well.
Good luck in your search, Victor, but success eludes you today.
Any other day, and we would have been glad to help you.
New York just got a little bit safer…
Lady Geist was a monster that needed to be put down…
You're a long way from The Met, my friend…
So that was the thing prowling our tunnels…
We're not afraid of you, Seven…
We can't let Seven complete the ritual!
She didn't have enough bullets to take us out…
Oh dear, I think she was a fed…
She really thought she could hide from us…
And now we made an enemy of the OSIC, this day keeps getting better…
You have the money, but we have Maurice.
The ghost lady is dead. Well, she was already dead I suppose, but now she's even more dead.
Getting our claws on her wasn't easy…
Should have flown away when you had the chance, Vindicta…
I like my fur unburned, thank you very much…
Oh, Mo, he didn't burn you too badly, did he?
It was a good fight, Kelvin.
Beating Lash is always a high point of any day.
Some humility would do you well, Lash.
If we lost that fight we'd never hear the end of it.
Listen they really did have an incredible stage show, it's a shame what's become of them.
I tire of your rabbit tricks.
It's ok, Momo… they won't be turning you into a rabbit anymore.
you're the best the djinn could hire?
You know I was expecting more from him.
Ego catches up with all of us.
There's nothing like beating an egomaniac…
Sorry, but we're not cat people. Come to think of it, we're not even people.
The poor girl didn't even realize she was being used.
Let this be a lesson on the dangers of obeying a Lich hand.
My dear, it's not safe to hang around with liches.
Your hunt is over Grey Talon.
Mo is not a trophy for you to collect Talon.
You should have stayed in retirement, my friend.
We will not be hunted by the likes of you…
We don't answer to the Vatican.
Why do I get the feeling he'd turn us into a rug if he had the chance…
Billy, you need to stop being angry at the world and start living for something.
There's few things more disappointing than a man with a megaphone and nothing to say.
May we never grow to be as nihilistic as that goat man.
I'm sure Billy will be whining about us in no time…
I'm sure Billy will be whining about us in no time.
You're a slippery, slippery, man, Shiv.
Those knives were never going to stop Maurice.
Let's be honest, that kid made some poor choices…
We protected you, Pocket, and you betrayed us!
I expected more from you, Pocket
Why did you put us in this position…
It didn't have to end this way…
You're a long way from Spanish Harlem, Ivy…
A pity. I liked that one.
Don't feel bad, Ivy, destroying stone is kind of our thing.
In another life she would have been our friend.
We probably should stay away from Coney for a while.
We did what we had to too, Momo.
You will be missed, my dear.
Personally, I find her fashion line to be overwrought, but who am I to judge?
She was a cruel little girl…
There are the dregs of society, and then there is Vyper.
I'll say this about Vyper… actually, there's nothing nice to say about Vyper she's just kind of a terrible person.
It is a privilege to give Vyper what was coming to her…
Do not mourn that snake of a woman…
Mo, I think you still got some goo on you.
My friend, you have some goo in your fur
Euck, I think some of Viscous got in my mouth.
Go back to the Deep, goo boy.
Warden, this isn't the fight for you.
We were never your enemy, Warden, I wish you could have seen that
Silver won't be feasting on us…
Silver, you were never going to beat Maurice.
And here I thought we had a good working relationship with her.
I didn't realize how desperate Silver had gotten… I wish we could have helped her.
I thought we had a deal, Wraith!
You're good at one-on-one fights, Wraith… too bad there's two of us.
You really thought you'd get the drop on us?
Those parlor tricks of yours were only going to get you so far…
That monstronsity will be back, but we still have some time…
Get out of New York, Wrecker…
The 7th Moon will never strong arm us!
You think we're afraid of you, Yamato?
A sword was never going to be enough to stop us.
Mo, she didn't cut you too bad, did she?
They have no chance at stopping us!
You know there's no shame in just giving up…
You can't hide from Maurice and I!
Maurice and I are just getting started…
These people wouldn't last two hours in the tunnels…
I can't believe we were nervous about fighting these people…
No one is better than us!
If you're looking for mercy, my friends, I'm afraid it's in short supply…
Looks like we're the only ones still standing…
Mo…perhaps now's the time to play it a little safer…
I can't help but notice all our new friends are dead.
The time has come to complete the ritual..
The ritual will be over soon…
Now let's go summon a Patron…
You're on your own for now…
We'll be back when we can…
We should find a place to rest up…
Your revolver is a thing to behold.
I don't suppose it's for sale.
I wouldn't respect myself if I didn't ask.
Sheriff, I know that you're new to our great city. But if you ever find yourself in need of information, Mo and I are happy to avail ourselves to you.
I think you'll find our rates to be reasonable.
Just pull them to Maurice, and I'll make sure we finish the job.
I was thinking the latter, but if you want to mastermind something we're all ears.
Abrams, I know this isn't exactly the most ideal time to bring it up but do you remember last weeks card game?
Aa delight for us as well. Our enemies will likely be less enthused…
You can count on us Bebop
Great job at the fights the other night
Bebop: you have gift, one that we can gamble on. Please don't waste it.
Sorry we couldn't do more for her
Thank you for banning Silver from brunch at The Baroness
Well our sofa and rug appreciate that you made the right choice.
If life was perfect it would be boring.
It's hard to picture Maurice and I running around in matching uniforms.
Very well, the hat can stay. But no vest.
I don't know if I'd call us predators.
I, uh, I suppose it does.
It is a common threat, but not a common occurrence.
The thought has crossed our minds.
Professor, you teach at Columbia yes?
I don't suppose you have any connections in the art department. Mo was hoping to audit a pottery class.
Ah well, I guess we'll fall back on the original plan of threatening someone in the admissions office
You've made his day Professor, thank you
We will endeavor not to grab someone in your black hole.
We have lived quite the life, yes.
What are you thinking? Jewels, fine art, Ixian trinkets?
My friend, what if I told you I knew someone looking to move a first edition Don Quixote
That does make it a challenge, but one I gladly accept. I will find you options.
Oh, you don't need to worry about Maurice, he's a teddy bear. Well, mole. Teddy mole. No, that doesn't work either. I'm just going to assume you can understand nuance.
No need to get sassy, my friend.
Of course not. We are equals.
Because he's not interested in talking to you.
I hope you're not above fighting dirty.
No. But there is great satisfaction in being alive.
Well if it isn't the crown prince of North Ixia.
We're just criminals. You on the other hand, are a monster.
No. I'd be wasting my breath.
This is Manhattan, of course we find body parts in the sewers.
We find body parts, we don't keep them, who do you take us for?
You look like somethings on your mind Victor.
Let's never speak of this again.
It won't be long until our enemies howl in frustration.
Lady Geist, for now our purposes are aligned. But if you wish for that pretty arm of yours to remain attached after the ritual, I suggest you be kinder to Maurice.
That binding ward on your arm is very impressive.
Whoever made it was an artist at their craft.
It's nice to meet you Lady Geist
It does. It also plays a critical role in your survival so perhaps we should try that again. It's nice to meet you Lady Geist.
I hear you've made the old subway tunnels your home.
Is the OSIC still looking for you?
We can help, but the rate will be higher
Do you want to come up with a plan.
So you're one of the fabled Sandmen of the OSIC.
How impressed will I be when I see my tax dollars at work?
Once momo grabs them they'll be easy for you shoot.
This is going to work out well, I can tell.
Today doesn't end with us getting arrested, right
Fern, haven't seen you at the game in a while
Afraid she'll want to pull you back in?
Not bad. Work is interesting and violent, I'm 31 chapters into my memoir, momo's trying his paws at pottery.
My friend, if I died before I got to tell the world of our adventures it would be a far greater crime than any we've committed,
How's Hank doing? I heard the bar is going through a…transitional period.
If there's anything we can do, let us know.
Your adventures were inspiring to read about Kelvin
They were riveting. I'm a… I'm a bit of an author myself actually.
If you would be willing to take a look at my manuscript -
Respect and certain death have a way of binding people together don't they.
I actually moved quite a few pieces from your ixian expedition.
Certainly not the ones that are still in the MET. Yet.
I see there are no shortage of stones in your glass house.
So is it safe to assume there is one mummified Ixian skull in your possession?
Any plans for the next heist?
When we hold them down, you take the shot.
Your war against The Friends of Humanity is a just one.
And yet you have it all the same.
Vindicta, no one chooses to live in the sewers if there was a better option available.
It is a fascinating piece of antiquity.
No. I in fact do not have a death wish.
Our ears are kept to the proverbial and literal ground, yes.
Your beard is a thing of beauty.
I'm not sure if mane is the proper nomenclature
You're the man making life hell for the friends of humanity, yes?
Traditionally we deal with objects more than people, but for you we'd be happy to ask some questions
Are you ready to go hunting Talon?
Are you ready to say anything else?
How are you adjusting to life in the Baxter Society?
But you stab more monsters, right?
You ever worry that your past is going to catch up with you?
Don't worry about us, Shiv. Just be sure you're ready once we grab them.
We weren't going to let you do this alone.
I know. That's why we're facing it as a family.
You don't need to thank us. It was a privilege.
If this is to be farewell, let it be a day that will be remembered.
Viscous, do you know if your goo washes out of fur easily
Yes. that’s why I’m asking about it’s properties never mind we will figure it out as we go
How could we say no to forced conscription
Wraith. Is that compassion I hear?
Wraith, If things go bad and we-
I'm serious. Friends come rarely in our line of work. And it's an honor to be counted amongst yours.
We have no interest in pit fighting
I'm sure after the ritual, Maurice would be happy to humble you.
What do you have in mind?
Why do you say Boosh all the time, it’s not even a word
A pleasure to see you again Calico.
As much as we can in our line of work.
It was a privilege. I'm sorry we couldn't do more.
Your ward is looking ravishing as always.
There are cats. There are queens. And then there is Ava.
Nice lich hand, is it for sale.
Well, if you ever want to get rid of it let me know.
Where did you find the lich hand?
You know who it belongs to?
We've heard the museum at the Vatican holds spectacular artifacts.
Alas, we don’t have passports, so any heists we conceive will remain theoretical.
I've heard stories of venators, but I never thought I'd meet one.
You're the gargoyle that rode Mendoza out on a rail, yes?
Because horrible people tend to have the most money.
Parquet floors don't just arrive in your hovel, Ivy
You don't have to spend your life hiding in a circus.
I think we're doing just fine on our own.
Last time we did business it didn't exactly work out well for us.
And how is our favorite malcontent doing?
Much better to fight alongside you, then against you
You certainly were in rare form.
It's fine. You'll pay us back later.
Our alliance is temporary, I'm afraid…Maurice and I value our independence.
Your bargaining posture leaves something to be desired.
I am merely admiring from afar.
I know you didn't ask me, but the 7th Moon would be thriving if you were willing to be more open to collaboration
Mo, you got some blood on your fur.
Maurice, it is a pleasure watching you work.
What sort of idiot gets in a fist fight with a mole person?
They won't be so lucky next time…
Don't worry, Mo: next time they won't escape.
We have them on the run!
Mo, that's…that's a lot of them…
Maybe we should think about digging a tunnel…
You think you can outfight Mo?
You'll never beat Maurice in a fist fight.
If they're gonna drop it, we're gonna pick it up.
Well well well… someone dropped their souls…
Far be from me to let this go to waste…
That's how to make an entrance!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Looks like we got our revenge, Maurice…
I just want this to be over…
Mo, I don’t know how we win this...
I…I…I don't know what to do.
We shouldn’t leave the souls just laying around…
This might be our lucky day…
It's not the rats in New York they should worry about…
He does the digging, I do the talking. We tried it the other way but it didn't work.
I am Krill, this is Maurice, and we are at your service.
Mo and I are a package deal.
There's nothing Maurice can't claw through.
Don't mind Maurice, he's not chatty around new people.
I got the gun, he's got the claws.
Don't mind the big guy, he's friendly… unless of course you try to stop us in which case he will definitely maul you.
Maurice and I got your back.
So you need a couple Tunnel Rats, eh?
Can't forget to check out the store…
Wonder what we can buy now.
I'm sure there's something worth spending our money on.
I can afford a powerful relic.
We might want to spend what we've saved…
We can put these souls to good use…
No point in saving any more souls…
I think it's time we go shopping, Mo.
I can't wait to see what the shop has in store…
We're closer to completing the ritual…
Look at them, scrambling to find a silver lining…
We got the real prize, let them take some scraps…
Another part of the ritual complete…
The objective's down, that all that matters.
Guess you don't need us after all.
False alarm, Maurice, let's go back to the tunnels.
You're going to wish you had the Tunnel Rats on your side.
You sure about that? You get two for the price of one.
Come on, put us in the fight…
You obviously don't appreciate the value of a good mole person.
It's alright, Maurice, who wants to get shot at anyway?
Alas, duty calls. And by duty: I mean crime.
It's fine, we needed a day off.
Maurice? He doesn’t care. Me? I'd be lying if I didn't say my feelings were hurt.
We'll get in there and give 'em hell…
We'll never back down from a fight…
We'll be the last one standing…
We'll turn their numbers against them…
We need to keep the pressure on them…
Don't worry, Mo, I'll keep you healthy…
You know how hard it is to keep Maurice down?
We aren't afraid to get up close.
They can try to outnumber us, but it won't go well for them.
There's nothing Maurice can't burrow through…
won't lie, this always weirds me out.
I love watching Maurice do his thing…
We gotta be smart how we come at 'em…
Hard to get shot when you're underground…
Some people say it's fighting dirty, I say it's fighting to survive.
There's a fine line between fighting smart and fighting dirty.
Don't worry, Maurice, I got some tricks up my sleeve.
Hard to fight when there's sand in your eyes…
Who cares if it's not fair, it works!
I'm not afraid to take short cuts.
I'll take any advantage I can get.
This can create the opening we need.
I'll do whatever it takes to win.
Alright, Maurice, here's the plan: I hold 'em down, you maul them.
Mo… I can't wait for you to get your claws on them…
I'll hold 'em down and let Maurice do his thing.
We'll hunt 'em down, and Maurice'll eat 'em. Well, not eat so much as pummel them to death.
The two of us can take down anyone.
Once we get our hands on 'em, and by we I mean Maurice, they're done for.
Everyone has a plan until they're grabbed by a moleman.
Maurice'll make short work of anyone.
I'll be ready to lock 'em down.
If there's any stragglers, we'll pick 'em off.
They're not going to like what happens next…
Let's see them try to heal now…
We're not worried about getting shot!
The more of them the better!
We don't back down from anyone!
You think you got the edge?
I can't hold them for long!
You messed with the wrong team!
No one will see us coming…
They won't be able to use their powers…
Come on, Maurice, we need to push through!
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
You're on your own for now…
We'll be back when we can…
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
I couldn't have done it without you, Maurice.
And now we receive what we so richly deserve.
We couldn't have done this without all of your help.
We won because we worked together as a team.
Alight, Mo, let's have some fun.
I don't expect any of you are familiar with moleman etiquette?
I am Krill, this is Maurice - please don't confuse us it's fairly rude.
Realistically this is 7 on 6 so I like our chances.
My friends, Mo and I will create opportunities, but it falls on you to seize them.
I see a whoooole lotta goo.
I see… a purple. Thing. With eyes.
Time to make some new friends…
When I grab them, be ready…
I'll pull one of them out of the fight….
Ready to see what a moleman can do?
Alright, Maurice, let's say hello as violently as possible.
I hope we find someone walking alone…
We're ready for the next team fight…
